title: The Lighthouse Cat
pages: A small gray cat named Pebble climbed out of a fishing boat and onto the rocky island.
At the top of the hill stood a tall white lighthouse. Pebble decided it looked like a good home.
The old keeper, Mr. Orla, opened the door and said, 'You may stay, if you catch the mice.'
That night, dark clouds rolled in and the wind began to howl around the tower.
Mr. Orla lit the great lamp, but a gust blew out the flame. The sea below was black.
Pebble leapt onto the lamp stand and knocked the matchbox to the keeper's feet. He relit the light just in time.
By morning the storm had passed, and a fishing boat floated safely past the rocks.
Mr. Orla set out a bowl of cream. Pebble purred. The lighthouse had its cat.
